name: odysseia-dojo
description: Fixture-only public site for 类脑 Odysseia - 道馆挑战.

scripts.format: npm run content:fixtures && prettier --check .github/workflows/public-fixture-ci.yml .prettierrc.json eslint.config.mjs package.json README.md scripts/verify-fixture-output.mjs scripts/verify-fixture-references.mjs scripts/verify-public-fixture-boundary.mjs test/fixture-output-isolation.test.mjs test/fixture-reference-validation.test.mjs test/public-fixture-boundary.test.mjs test/public-fixture-ci.test.mjs docs/public-fixture-ci.md
scripts.test: npm run content:fixtures && node --test test/content-assembly.test.mjs test/public-build-config.test.mjs test/public-fixture-ci.test.mjs test/public-fixture-boundary.test.mjs test/fixture-output-isolation.test.mjs test/fixture-reference-validation.test.mjs test/observation-logic.test.mjs test/observation-client.test.mjs test/quiz-eligibility.test.mjs test/investigation-queries.test.mjs test/mascot-controller.test.mjs test/site-closure.test.mjs test/d-meow-state.test.mjs test/d-meow-branding.test.mjs
scripts.test:frontend: npm run content:fixtures && node --test test/mascot-controller.test.mjs test/site-closure.test.mjs test/d-meow-state.test.mjs test/d-meow-branding.test.mjs
scripts.test:worker: npm run content:fixtures && npm run build && node --test test/worker-harness.test.mjs
scripts.build: npm run content:fixtures && npm run verify:fixture-boundary && node scripts/validate-public-build-config.mjs && astro build && node scripts/verify-fixture-output.mjs
scripts.validate: npm run content:fixtures && npm run verify:fixture-boundary && npm run format && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run check && npm run verify:fixture-references && npm run build && npm run test:worker
scripts.preview: npm run content:fixtures && npm run build && astro preview
